paper_title: Downregulation of semaphorin 4A in keratinocytes reflects the features of non-lesional psoriasis
authors: Kume M, Koguchi-Yoshioka H, Nakai S, Matsumura Y, Tanemura A, Yokoi K, ... Watanabe R
target_figure_description: Volcano plot of differential gene expression in psoriatic non-lesional (NL) skin vs control (Ctl), from bulk RNA-sequencing (GSE121212), analysed with RaNA-seq. x = log2 fold-change, y = -log10 adjusted p-value; up-regulated keratinocyte/antimicrobial genes (SPRR2F, SERPINB4, DEFB4B, S100A7/8/9, PI3, CXCL8) labelled in red near top-right.
underlying_data: GEO GSE121212 (psoriasis/atopic-dermatitis/control skin transcriptomes); the figure's own values are provided as eLife Figure 5-source data 1, sheet 'Figure 5A'.
